The following events took place in '''24 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
*The former [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] reappears on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]].
*Formation of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] on Raxus Prime by the newly formed [[Separatist Council/Legends|Separatist Council]].
*The [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Separatist Droid Army]] begins to be manufactured.
*The [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] begins.
*Palpatine reaches the end of his second term as [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]]; the passage of the [[Emergency Powers Act/Legends|Emergency Powers Act]] allows him to stay in office until the crisis is dealt with.
*[[Granta Omega]] plots two assassination attempts on [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and though they are averted by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], 21 [[Senator/Legends|senators]] are killed.<ref name="False Peace">''[[Jedi Quest: The False Peace]]''</ref>
*The [[Military Creation Act/Legends|Military Creation Act]] is proposed.
*[[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] (five years old) joined the crew of the [[Liberator (Liberator-class)|''Trader's Luck'']].<ref name="TPS">''[[The Paradise Snare]]''</ref>
*[[Jobal Rapier]] and [[Yari Cranna-Rapier]] get married.<ref name="hnn life">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|51|life/13411_3.html|Jobal and Yari Split Up}}</ref>
*The [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] becomes a member of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.<ref name="GORW">''[[Geonosis and the Outer Rim Worlds]]''</ref>
